coverage_assessment: Nonexhaustive open-web first pass: 30 captured French/English and exploratory Bambara/Bamanankan searches yielded 638 ordered result headers. Raw rollout outputs and all 30 stored query records match one by one; 638 supersedes inconsistent interim counts of 665 and 637. Forty unique source cards remain search-only. Three candidate gatherings remain pending_evidence; no attendance threshold of 50 is established. Twelve exclusions preserve work stoppages without documented gatherings, an overseas France event, prospective statements and date/episode false leads. No event is approved or integrated. Exactly four body-request invocations occurred (three web.open Cache misses and one DNS failure before HTTP); all four have matching attempt outcomes and none read a body or encountered an observed denial. Initial and renewed gates, including two Kibaru checks, stopped before any further network request and are documented as no-request deferrals. LexisNexis-equivalent coverage, fluent local-language review, source independence, candidate crowd counts, event endpoints and official baseline/manual remain unresolved; no absence or exhaustiveness claim.
